newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: McCollam weighs Blue Star takeover offer.
newsitem.headline: McCollam weighs Blue Star takeover offer.

text.p: McCollam Printers Ltd said on Monday it had formed a committee to assess Blue Star's takeover offer and had appointed Merrill Lynch to advise it.
Blue Star Investments, controlled by U.S. Office Products Co, on Friday said it intended to table a takeover bid at NZ$2.75 per share for all the capital of McCollam Printers.
The bid values McCollam at about NZ$65 million, according to market observers' estimates of the size of its share capital.
Blue Star said the conditional cash offer was intended to be dated June 3 and would be despatched within three days after that date.
The offer is conditional on the McCollam family and associated interests separately agreeing terms for the sale of the ir 38 percent stake.
Company chairman Brian Allison and Andrew Harmos have formed an independent committee of directors to consider the offer.
They said it was intended that arrangement would be made to ensure that holders of McCollam options would be able to participate in the offer.
